entities.name: Ilse Beatrice Twardowski-Conrat
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ilse von Twardowski or Ilse Twardowski-Conrat (1880–1942) was an Austrian sculptor. She created many noted sculptures. She took her own life in 1942 as a result of the Holocaust.
